gaps.sentence: ___ of the workforce is part-time now.
gaps.hint: pattern: ___ of + specific group; singular verb
gaps.explanation: 'Half of the workforce is ...' is the correct pattern; 'the half of' is not used in this position.

gaps.sentence: We had five applications, but ___ of the candidates was suitable.
gaps.hint: more than two candidates + singular verb
gaps.explanation: 'None of the candidates was ...' is used for three or more; 'neither' is reserved for two.

gaps.sentence: I'd like ___ more time to think about your offer.
gaps.explanation: 'A little more time' means a small additional amount; 'time' is uncountable so 'a few' is wrong.

gaps.sentence: The box was empty — there was ___ inside.
gaps.explanation: 'Empty' explains 'there was nothing inside'; the other options contradict emptiness.

gaps.sentence: ___ of her two brothers lives abroad.
gaps.explanation: 'Each of her two brothers lives ...' is correct; 'every' cannot take 'of' and 'both/all' need a plural verb.

gaps.sentence: There isn't ___ room for another desk in here.
She has ___ patience with excuses; deliver on time or do not bother coming.
gaps.explanation: 'Has no patience with' — 'no' directly negates the noun.

gaps.sentence: ___ the food was eaten within minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'All the food' is correct with an uncountable noun; 'whole' needs 'the whole of' and 'both' needs two separate items.
